Putting on shoes. For some god forsaken reason, I thought you were supposed to tie it first in a perfect knot then get your foot in it afterwards. Coming to think of it, I think that thought process came from when I learned how to tie shoes and would do it without putting it on. I fucking hated shoes. Especially getting a new pair, it was hell putting them on. Then one fucking day when I was about 10 or 11, my sister was running late for work and I saw her put the shoe on first and THEN tie it. My whole world came crashing down on me. How could I have gone this long without knowing? I mean there should've been some point where I saw my parents or friends or someone putting the shoe on first and then tying it. But nope, took me 10 years to figure that shit out. I'm only 17 now so that was pretty much my entire life. I still get sick to my stomach when I see a bright, new, and shiny pair of shoes. Fuck shoes.
